entries.title: What hidden stems are
entries.content: Each of the 12 animal branches carries one to three heavenly stems inside it, called hidden stems (jijanggan, 지장간). They show the deeper energies a branch brings to a chart.
entries.source: Four Pillars of Destiny - Wikipedia; Master Sean Chan BaZi calculator
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Rat 子 and Rabbit 卯
entries.content: Rat holds Gye 癸 Water. Rabbit holds Eul 乙 Wood. These two are 'pure' branches with one main hidden stem.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Horse 午 and Rooster 酉
entries.content: Horse holds Jeong 丁 Fire with Gi 己 Earth. Rooster holds Sin 辛 Metal.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Tiger 寅, Snake 巳, Monkey 申, Pig 亥
entries.content: Tiger holds Gap 甲 Wood, Byeong 丙 Fire, Mu 戊 Earth. Snake holds Byeong 丙 Fire, Mu 戊 Earth, Gyeong 庚 Metal. Monkey holds Gyeong 庚 Metal, Im 壬 Water, Mu 戊 Earth. Pig holds Im 壬 Water and Gap 甲 Wood.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Ox 丑, Dragon 辰, Goat 未, Dog 戌
entries.content: These four Earth branches are 'storage' branches. Ox: Gi 己, Gye 癸, Sin 辛. Dragon: Mu 戊, Eul 乙, Gye 癸. Goat: Gi 己, Jeong 丁, Eul 乙. Dog: Mu 戊, Sin 辛, Jeong 丁.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Why they matter
entries.content: An element can look missing on the surface but still be hidden inside a branch. Readers check hidden stems before calling an element truly absent.
entries.source: Master Sean Chan BaZi calculator guide
